evidenceType: Official batch-specific product quality recall notice, not a clinical trial or causal risk study
dateCaveat: Page modification is not proof of first publication time; displayed November 1 is a calendar date. Recall action predates notice.
issue: Black spots on tablets; precautionary recall of this batch.
officialInstructionScope: Hospitals, clinics and pharmacies are told to cease supplying the affected batch and return remaining stock to the company. This notebook issues no individual medication advice.
interpretation: Relevant watched medicine, but product/batch quality issue. Does not establish a class-wide hazard, a Tourette-specific risk, clinical outcome or new mechanism. HSA describes Class 2 issues as unlikely to cause serious adverse health outcomes; this is not a zero-risk claim.
nextDecision: Retain batch and dates; follow official corrections/outcomes in later bounded scans without treatment changes.
